provenance.prompt: A sprite sheet for a cannabis dispensary website: a neat 4 by 4 grid of 16 different whole cannabis flower buds, each one isolated and centred in its own cell with generous empty pure black space around it, no bud touching or overlapping another, on a flat pure black background. Every bud is a different strain and clearly different in shape, size and colour: lime green, olive green, deep forest green, chartreuse, emerald, pale sage and mint-green buds, some with bright orange pistils, some with rust-red or cream pistils. Each bud seen whole, from the side, filling about two thirds of its cell. Macro studio product photography, soft even light, crisp focus, sparkling trichome frost, realistic. No text, no labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no borders, no shadows, no loose leaves, no smoke, no hands.
